description: Land Title Settlement Department - Egoda Uyana, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No.  520217
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for specific land parcels (No. 166 and 167) in Colombo District. It contains detailed information about land ownership, property boundaries, mortgages, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
